composed.brief:
The new Ageless digital experience must transition from a passive brochure to a high-converting luxury funnel. The design language will utilize a 'Quiet Luxury' aesthetic: generous negative space, a refined editorial grid, and high-contrast typography that commands authority. The color palette is strictly anchored in deep midnight navy (#0C1721) for structural elements, with the cream (#F2EFE9) as the primary canvas to ensure maximum readability and warmth. The accent (#C5A075) will be reserved exclusively for high-intent interactive elements like primary CTAs, elevating them without disrupting the serene visual flow.

Layout rhythm must be intentional: the hero section will feature a full-bleed, high-fidelity portrait of a patient in a state of serene confidence, paired with a benefit-driven headline (e.g., 'The Art of Timeless Radiance') and a persistent 'Book Consultation' CTA. The navigation will move from a hidden hamburger to a visible, top-aligned menu, establishing immediate trust. We will implement a three-step 'Journey' section—Consultation, Customization, Transformation—to reduce cognitive load and guide the user toward conversion. 

To address the CRO audit, the site will integrate a 'Social Proof' ribbon immediately below the hero, featuring verified testimonials and a 'Results' preview gallery. Every section must utilize custom, non-stock photography: close-up macro shots of skin texture for treatment pages, and warm, natural-lit portraits of practitioners to humanize the brand. The mobile experience will prioritize a 'sticky' booking button that triggers a seamless modal overlay, preventing the friction of external redirects. By replacing long-form text blocks with scannable, modular content cards and ensuring all background watermarks maintain a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against text, we create a site that is as accessible as it is aspirational, effectively turning visitors into high-value clients.

IMAGERY: Utilize high-key, warm-toned editorial photography featuring soft-focus skin textures and candid, authentic provider-patient interactions. All imagery must follow a consistent 'Golden Hour' color grade with deep shadows and luminous highlights to emphasize a premium, clinical, yet intimate atmosphere.

composed.brief:
The Ruma brand evolution prioritizes a 'Serene Authority' aesthetic, balancing high-end editorial minimalism with rigorous accessibility. Layouts will utilize a 12-column grid with generous 80px+ vertical gutters to enforce an architectural rhythm. The hero section will feature a 40% dark-overlay on high-definition video assets to ensure WCAG-compliant white text contrast. The navigation is overhauled into a 'Mega-Menu' category system, replacing the dense list with intuitive, icon-led treatment groupings. Typography utilizes Playfair Display for editorial impact in headings, paired with Montserrat for high-legibility body copy, ensuring consistent hierarchy across all viewports. Component styling shifts to 'soft-edge' containers (8px border-radius) to soften the luxury feel. 

To address CRO deficits, the site introduces a three-tiered trust architecture: a 'Featured Results' carousel positioned immediately below the hero, a 'New Patient Concierge' AI chat widget for hesitant leads, and a 'Treatment Finder' quiz that maps user concerns to specific services. The booking path is restructured into a multi-step flow that includes educational 'Journey Maps'—explaining the process from intake to aftercare—to reduce anxiety. Imagery is strictly curated: we move away from generic stock, utilizing high-contrast, warm-toned portraits of actual providers to humanize the clinical experience. Background watermarks are reduced to 5% opacity, ensuring they act as subtle texture rather than visual noise. Finally, the mobile experience is refined with a 'drawer-style' menu featuring a prominent 'X' close-gesture, and service descriptions are rewritten to focus on patient-centric benefits rather than technical jargon, utilizing a 'problem/solution' framework to drive conversions.

IMAGERY: Art direction focuses on 'Golden Hour' clinical photography: soft-focus, high-dynamic-range shots of practitioners in crisp white lab coats against warm, textured stone interiors. Results imagery must be macro-level, emphasizing skin texture and light reflection to convey health and efficacy rather than clinical sterility.

composed.brief:
The new PrettyPlease digital experience must pivot from clinical utility to 'Elevated Sanctuary.' We will replace the current sterile minimalism with a 'Warm Luxury' design language. The layout will utilize a fluid 12-column grid with generous, consistent gutters to eliminate mobile crowding. Typography shifts to a high-contrast pairing: Playfair Display for editorial-style headings and Inter for high-legibility, accessible body copy. The color palette is refined for accessibility: #1A1A1A (replacing pure black) for text, #B84A6E (a deeper, more sophisticated rose) for primary actions, and #F7F2EF as a soft, warm canvas to reduce eye strain. 

Strategic CRO implementation is non-negotiable. We will replace the current navigation split with a singular, high-intent 'Book Consultation' CTA in the header, triggering a persistent, slide-in drawer that allows booking without page exits. The homepage will feature a 'Treatment Discovery' engine—a lead magnet offering a personalized treatment plan—positioned above the fold to capture top-of-funnel leads. To build trust, we will anchor every treatment section with 'Before & After' galleries paired with patient testimonials, ensuring social proof is adjacent to every conversion point. 

Technical performance is prioritized by moving away from heavy Elementor-widget CSS; we will utilize lightweight, atomic design blocks to prevent CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift). Mobile navigation will be flattened into a simplified 'hamburger' overlay, reducing interaction cost from four taps to two. We will integrate 'Limited Availability' badges on high-demand services to drive urgency. Imagery will be strictly editorial: close-up, macro-texture shots of skin results paired with wide-angle, warm-lit shots of the clinic interior to humanize the brand. By marrying high-fashion editorial aesthetics with aggressive, data-driven conversion paths, we transform PrettyPlease from a service provider into a premium lifestyle destination.

composed.brief:
The new Ageless digital experience will pivot from a passive brochure to a high-conversion luxury funnel. We will establish a 'Golden Ratio' layout: generous negative space (min. 120px section padding) paired with a high-contrast, editorial grid. The hero section must act as the primary conversion engine, featuring a full-bleed, high-fidelity portrait of the Ageless methodology in action, overlaid with a bold H1 that clearly defines our value proposition. We are eliminating the 'dead zone' by integrating a persistent, non-intrusive 'Book Consultation' CTA in the primary header, alongside a secondary 'Call' button (tel: link) to remove all mobile friction. 

Typography will follow a strict hierarchy: Cormorant Garamond for all display headings (using tracked-out letter spacing) and Montserrat for body copy to ensure maximum readability and modern sophistication. We will replace the current chaotic palette with a refined, WCAG-compliant system: deep charcoal (#0A141E) for structural elements, a warm stone (#F2F0ED) for background breathing room, and a muted, metallic champagne (#C5A072) for high-intent actions. 

To address CRO failures, the build will implement a 'Problem/Agitation/Solution' content framework: the hero will transition into a 'Social Proof' strip featuring real patient results and trust badges before the fold. We will introduce skeleton loading states to ensure immediate visual feedback, maintaining the premium 'Ageless' feel even during transitions. Every image will be curated for editorial consistency—avoiding stock-photo plasticity in favor of authentic, warm-toned portraits of practitioners and macro-shots of treatment textures. The 'Quick Actions' mobile bar will be pinned to the bottom of the viewport, ensuring that booking or calling is never more than a thumb-tap away, effectively moving the site from a 76/100 to a 95+ performance tier.

composed.brief:
The PrettyClone brand evolution transitions from 'minimalist-clinical' to 'refined-organic luxury.' The design system will utilize a strict 1440px container max-width to prevent the 40/60 imbalance, anchored by a high-contrast, sticky navigation bar featuring a persistent 'Book Now' CTA and a 'Quick Contact' utility. We are replacing the fragmented location-selection flow with a unified, smart-routing booking widget that detects user intent via IP or preference. The typographic hierarchy elevates the brand: Playfair Display for editorial-style headlines and Inter for a highly legible, sophisticated body experience. Color usage is refined for WCAG compliance; the primary black is softened to #1A1A1A, and the secondary pink is deepened to a muted rose #B87389 to ensure accessibility without sacrificing the premium aesthetic. 

Section rhythm will follow a 'Story-Proof-Action' cadence: The Hero section will integrate a high-intent 'Before & After' carousel and a secondary 'Virtual Consultation' lead magnet to capture top-of-funnel leads. Social proof is woven throughout, featuring real-time booking counters and verified patient testimonials placed strategically below the fold. The 'Resources' section will be redesigned as an educational hub, utilizing a card-based layout to drive long-term SEO authority. Every element—from the high-density vector favicon to the high-contrast hover states—is engineered for conversion. We are moving away from purely transactional CTAs to value-based prompts, such as 'Start Your Transformation.' SEO meta-data will be localized for Sacramento and Roseville to capture high-intent search traffic, while the overall layout will maintain generous whitespace to communicate a high-end, unhurried patient experience. The layout will utilize a 12-column grid with generous negative space, replacing cluttered sections with a rhythmic, editorial flow. Every treatment page will feature a 'Patient Persona' section ('Who this is for') followed by a direct social-proof module—placing verified testimonials and before-and-after results immediately above the primary 'Book a Consultation' CTA. Technical UX refinements include increasing mobile navigation hit-areas to 48px to accommodate touch precision and adding a 'Quick-Book' button to the mobile menu overlay. The hero section will transition to a static-content section via a subtle, animated 'scroll-to-discover' indicator to reduce bounce rates. Content strategy will pivot from clinical technicalities to benefit-driven narratives, focusing on the 'emotional transformation' of the patient. Finally, we will replace engraved background watermarks with subtle, high-opacity architectural overlays that sit behind content blocks, ensuring they never compete with navigation or conversion triggers, maintaining a clean, professional, and accessible user experience throughout the entire ecosystem.

composed.brief:
The new RUMA brand system shifts from 'clinical-luxury' to 'bespoke-wellness' by anchoring the interface in a high-contrast, editorial layout. We will replace the current monochromatic fatigue with a 'Sand & Slate' palette: deep charcoal (#1A1A1A) for structural depth, paired with a sophisticated champagne-taupe (#D4C4B7) and a refined, metallic-gold accent (#C19A6B) specifically reserved for high-intent interactive elements. The typographic hierarchy will pair the timeless, high-contrast serifs of Playfair Display for editorial headlines with the clean, geometric precision of Montserrat for body legibility, ensuring WCAG compliance through increased tracking and line-height. 

Layout rhythm will transition from static imagery to an 'architectural scroll,' using arched motifs and negative space to guide the eye. To solve the CRO audit, we are implementing a persistent, glass-morphism sticky header that houses a high-contrast 'Begin Your Transformation' CTA, replacing the passive 'Book a Visit.' The hero section will pivot to a split-screen layout: a cinematic, high-frame-rate video loop of the clinic’s interior on one side, and a benefit-driven, concise value proposition on the other. 

To humanize the patient journey, we will integrate a 'Concierge Path' section that replaces standard FAQs with a step-by-step visual guide of the consultation process, effectively lowering the barrier to entry. Social proof will be woven into the site via a 'Live Momentum' ticker—displaying real-time booking activity—and a curated 'Results Gallery' that utilizes hover-state overlays to show patient testimonials alongside treatment photography. Performance is prioritized through lazy-loading video assets, responsive touch-target expansion for mobile navigation, and a floating, non-intrusive 'Concierge' chat widget designed to capture high-intent leads without interrupting the aesthetic experience. Every component will be built with a mobile-first mindset, ensuring that the luxury feel remains consistent across all device breakpoints.

IMAGERY: Utilize a warm, cinematic color grade with soft-focus bokeh and golden-hour ambient lighting to emphasize textures like skin, stone, and velvet. Compositions must be asymmetrical and editorial, featuring authentic, unposed portraits of providers in motion and macro-detail shots of clinical precision to bridge the gap between medical rigor and high-fashion luxury.
